_doc: The hub postprocess profiles this app offers under "Nachbearbeiten" (pushed by scripts/push-profiles.sh, which also pushes the transcription default dictation-medical-de). The app's dialog lists the hub's live /profiles; the dictations MCP server (mcp/src/resona_dictations_mcp/postprocess_tools.py, PROFILES) offers exactly these, since it never calls the hub. `instructions`: the profile has an llm/extract step, so the hub accepts user instructions for it (else 422 invalid_instructions). test/postprocessProfiles.spec.ts and mcp/tests/test_postprocess_tools.py keep the copies in step.

profiles.name: transcript-markdown-de
profiles.description: German dictation commands to Markdown (rules only, no language model): headings, paragraphs, punctuation.

profiles.name: transcript-polish-de
profiles.description: The same rules, then a language model fixes capitalization, punctuation and whitespace only; no word changes.
